sentences.en: The son exclaims so that the shepherds may flee.

sentences.la: Rēgīna ad hortum redit ut rēgulam servet.
sentences.en: The queen goes back to the garden to save the ruler.

sentences.la: Equitēs in mare veniunt ut lavent.
sentences.en: The horsemen come into the sea to wash.

sentences.la: Parentēs avunculum vocant quī arātrum spectet.
sentences.en: The parents call an uncle to watch the plow.

sentences.la: Iūlius fugit nē fēmina eum reperiat.
sentences.en: Julius flees so that the woman may not find him.

sentences.la: Gubernātōrēs portam claudunt nē marītus fugiat.
sentences.en: The helmsmen shut the gate so that the husband may not flee.

sentences.la: Coniūnx īnfantī dēnāriōs dat ut gladiōs emat.
sentences.en: The spouse gives the baby denarii so that he may buy the swords.

sentences.la: Iānitor celeriter proficīscitur ut prīmus veniat.
sentences.en: The doorkeeper sets out quickly to come first.

sentences.la: Ad flūmen pergimus ut dominōs laudēmus.
sentences.en: We go on to the river to praise the owners.

sentences.la: Rēgīna clāmat ut nūntiī redeant.
sentences.en: The queen shouts so that the messengers may go back.

sentences.la: Fabrī ad lūdum accurrunt ut comitēs spectent.
sentences.en: The craftsmen run up to the school to watch the companions.

sentences.la: Hostēs in ātrium intrant ut canant.
sentences.en: The enemies enter into the atrium to sing.

sentences.la: Faber adulēscentem vocat quī herbam spectet.
sentences.en: The craftsman calls a young man to watch grass.

sentences.la: Dux recēdit nē Sextus eum pūniat.
sentences.en: The leader goes back so that Sextus may not punish him.

sentences.la: Comes forem claudit nē praedō exeat.
sentences.en: The companion shuts the door so that the robber may not go out.

sentences.la: Puella magistrīs sēstertium dat ut folia emant.
sentences.en: The girl gives the teachers a sesterce so that they may buy the leaves.

sentences.la: Māter celeriter currit ut prīma veniat.
sentences.en: The mother runs quickly to come first.

sentences.la: Ad mare ambulāmus ut ānulōs quaerāmus.
sentences.en: We walk to the sea to look for the rings.

sentences.la: Mārcus exclāmat ut amīcī exeant.
sentences.en: Marcus exclaims so that the friends may go out.

sentences.la: Frātrēs ad campum redeunt ut tabellam reperiant.
sentences.en: The brothers go back to the field to find the small tablet.

sentences.la: Gubernātor in cubiculum redit ut cantet.
sentences.en: The helmsman goes back into the bedroom to sing.

sentences.la: Parentēs līberōs arcessunt quī Aemiliam ōrnent.
sentences.en: The parents send for children to adorn Aemilia.

sentences.la: Iūlius fugit nē Albīnus eum cōnsequātur.
sentences.en: Julius flees so that Albinus may not catch up with him.

sentences.la: Domina fenestram claudit nē rēx exeat.
sentences.en: The mistress shuts the window so that the king may not go out.

sentences.la: Marītus statim surgit ut prīmus veniat.
sentences.en: The husband gets up at once to come first.
